title: Alexander dies and his empire is divided
summary: Jones dates Alexander’s death and the division of his empire four ways.
description: Jones dates Alexander’s death and the division of his empire four ways. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed. The wars of his generals are a longer struggle. wars-of-the-diadochi keeps its own sort.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 323 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Not applied to wars-of-the-diadochi. Jones's line is the death and the division, not the wars that followed.
